text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. While Narita 
Taishin was away, an unexpected visitor 
arrived in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A visitor—Narita Taishin's mother—
explains 
the rift between mother and daughter, 
handing the Trainer a bouquet of flowers 
to show her support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
the Trainer handed a bouquet to 
Narita Taishin when she returned,
claiming 
it was from a fan, but she saw right 
through it immediately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says it doesn't matter whether her 
mother is watching or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—She resolved to just run for herself as 
always, and simply win.
